jobs.description:
Your responsibilities 
 

You will provide comprehensive administrative and organisational support to our lawyers.
 

Your responsibilities will include:
 

Matter and document support: opening and maintaining matters in the ERP system; preparing court documents; finalising submissions; monitoring deadlines; ensuring consistent document formatting. Financial administration: preparing and following up invoices; creating purchase requisitions and purchase orders; processing expense reports. Planning and logistics: managing calendars; organising internal and external meetings; arranging travel; coordinating hearing-related logistics. Data and compliance: maintaining CRM records and monitoring lawyers’ professional or bar-related obligations.

Essential
 

At least two years’ experience in an administrative, executive assistant or management assistant role. Excellent written and spoken Dutch and English. Proficiency in Microsoft Office. Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.  Desirable
 

Previous experience in a law firm or another professional-services environment. Working knowledge of French. Experience with ERP, document management or CRM systems.

jobs.occupation: Customer Service Officer English-German-Dutch – Day Shift
jobs.description:
As a Customer Service Officer, you’ll be part of a multicultural, multilingual support platform. Every day, our team ensures that our customers’ vehicles and trucks are back on the road as quickly as possible. You’ll work in a close-knit team with the support of a team leader and helpful colleagues. You’ll meet new people with unique backgrounds and stories, and you’ll have the opportunity to learn new things daily.

Your key responsibilities include handling incoming phone calls and emails, responding to customer queries and liaising with third parties. You’ll gather and verify information for accuracy and completeness, provide technical support, and communicate with service workshops. Keeping customers and all stakeholders informed is essential, as is monitoring and managing agreements with all parties. You’ll also follow up on all contract-related matters within set deadlines. The core working schedule is Monday to Friday, with flexibility to work Saturdays during busy periods. Shifts are rotated between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM.

An average day will see you juggling multiple customer queries, coordinating with technical teams, ensuring accurate and timely communication, and resolving any issues that may come up. You’ll need to multitask, prioritize tasks, and maintain a high standard of accuracy and customer service.

If you’re ready to take on a fast-paced, varied role in a supportive and international environment, apply now and start your journey in customer service!

• Professional bachelor’s degree or higher secondary education

• Excellent spoken English, good German and Dutch language skills

• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, Outlook)

• Strong verbal communication skills, analytical and problem-solving ability

• Customer-oriented, results-driven, accurate, and able to multitask under pressure

• Technical knowledge (automotive, tires, etc.) is a plus, but not required

• No specific work experience required; open to juniors and starters

• Able to work shifts between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM, Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturdays

Key Responsibilities

• 
Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and electronic issues in trucks

• 
Perform maintenance and repairs, including oil and filter changes, brake installation and bleeding, and component replacements

• 
Handle each assigned vehicle from A to Z, ensuring all required tasks are completed efficiently and accurately

• 
Document all work performed in line with company procedures

• 
Follow established time standards, safety guidelines, and quality requirements

• 
Cooperate with the workshop team and report to the workshop supervisor

• 
Education: Technical qualification or vocational training in truck mechanics or equivalent

• 
Experience: Minimum 3 years of relevant experience as a truck technician or diagnostic mechanic

• 
Driving licence: Category B required (C is an advantage)

• 
Languages: Basic communication skills in English or French

• 
Availability: Occasional on-call duty (once per month); no standard weekend work

Key Competencies

• 
Strong problem-solving ability and technical insight

• 
Team player with a proactive and reliable work attitude

• 
Adheres to safety standards and consistently uses PPE

• 
Open communicator, direct and honest in feedback

• 
Motivated to develop and grow within a professional workshop environment

Are you looking for a meaningful job where you contribute daily to improving the lives of patients with life-threatening diseases? As a Lab Technician you will work with a passionate team to develop groundbreaking therapies and make a real difference for patients worldwide.
 

Your key responsibilities:
 

 
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
 
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
 
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
 
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
 
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste. 

Who we are looking for:
 

 
• You have obtained a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
 
• Cell culture experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
 
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
 
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
 
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
 
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

Katoen Natie Gent is a logistics company specialized in storage, transport, and handling of goods. The company is located in the city of Ghent in Belgium, and the company has branches all over the world. Katoen Natie was founded in 1854 and has since grown into an international player in the field of logistics and supply chain management. The company offers a wide range of services, including warehouse management, transport and distribution, packaging, quality control, and customs clearance.Katoen Natie Gent is an important employer in the Ghent region and has a strong connection with the local community. The company has taken several initiatives in the past to support the local economy and has invested in sustainable logistics and innovation.

 

 

 

 

 

Jobomschrijving

 

We are currently looking for a motivated Terberg - Tugmaster driver (CE driver) for internal transport at Katoen Natie Gent. In this role, you will be responsible for safely and efficiently carrying out internal transport using a Terberg - Tugmaster tractor. You will be involved in moving goods and materials within our logistics environment and ensuring they are delivered to the correct locations.

 

 

• Operating the Terberg - Tugmaster tractor to move goods and materials within the facility.
• Loading and unloading trucks using the Terberg - Tugmaster tractor.
• Carefully checking goods and materials to ensure they match the corresponding documentation.
• Recording completed tasks and keeping track of inventory levels.
• Compliance with safety regulations and ensuring a safe working environment.
 

 

 

• Demonstrable experience as a Terberg - Tugmaster driver or operating similar tractors.
• You have a valid CE driver's license and code 95.
• Knowledge of applicable laws and regulations regarding internal transport.
• Familiarity with safety regulations and the ability to apply them correctly.
• Good communication skills in Dutch and/or English to effectively interact with colleagues.
• You are motivated and reliable and value safety and quality.
• You are flexible regarding hours and tasks.
• Willingness to work in two shifts or nightshift
• Good physical condition and capable of performing prolonged seated work.
• Attention to detail and precise execution of tasks.
• Expirience with a forklift long vorks is a plus!

Acting as a business partner to various departments, you will provide valuable insights that support operational efficiency and strategic decision-making.

jobs.occupation: Telephone Roadside Assistance Agent | Customer Support Officer | East-European Languages
jobs.description:
Help drivers get back on the road quickly and safely.

About the role: As a Telephone Roadside Assistance Agent, you are the first point of contact for drivers who experience a breakdown while on the road. You remain calm, ask the right questions, and make sure every driver receives the support they need. You coordinate interventions with partner services and keep the driver informed throughout the process. It's a role with real impact: thanks to your composure, communication skills, and problem-solving mindset, you make a genuine difference during stressful moments. Your responsibilities: 

 
•  
 Answer incoming calls from drivers experiencing vehicle breakdowns. 

 
• Assess the situation by asking targeted questions and gathering essential information. 
 
•  
Organise interventions and dispatch assistance to towing services, partners, or technicians. 

 
•  
Follow up each case from start to finish, ensuring clear and proactive communication with the driver. 

 
•  
Record all relevant data in the system (time, location, issue details, planning, updates...). 

 
• Stay calm in urgent situations and consistently act with customer focus. 
 
• Working together in a dedicated team: You will be part of a team that is committed 24/7 to providing our customers with the best possible support. 

What we expect from you : 

 
• Strong communication skills and the ability to speak clearly, empathetically, and professionally over the phone. 
 

 
• Stress resilience and the ability to maintain oversight in busy situations. 
 
•  
A natural talent for problem-solving. 

 
•  
Confidence in working with digital tools and administrative follow-up. 

 
• Willingness to work in a shift system: early, late, day, night and weekend work. 
 
• Experience in dispatching, customer service, or roadside assistance is an asset. 
 
•  
Fluent in English, Czech & another Eastern language (minimum B2 level).
